text:
morgan: Heads-up — I'm about to promote the prod overlay that moves DB secret paths from /staging to /prod. PR is up: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/912. Can someone do a quick sanity check on the Terraform plan and the k8s Secret name mapping?

james: quick skim — TF plan looks like only path renames + ssm->secretsmanager alias. paste of plan?

morgan: pasted plan snippet below:
```
# aws_secretsmanager_secret_version.prod_db (resource will be replaced)
-/+ resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "prod_db" {
    ~ secret_id = "arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-west-2:123456789012:secret:staging/db-creds" -> "arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-west-2:123456789012:secret:prod/db-creds"
    ...
  }
```

priya: That ARN change is expected. Two quick concerns: 1) ensure rotation config copied over, 2) check that RBAC for secretsmanager access is updated for the prod service account.

sam: For k8s overlay, I'm seeing we rename secret ref in deployment template: `envFrom: secretRef: name: db-creds-staging` -> `db-creds-prod`. Did we also update the namespace mapping?

morgan: Yes, overlay updates namespace to `prod-data` — but I want someone to confirm nothing else references the old name. grep'd main repo but might miss runtime refs.

olga: I can run a quick query on the config registry. Give me 5.

infra-bot: CI check started for PR #912 — terraform fmt, tfsec, and overlay-validate jobs queued.

james: Also flagging that the canary routing policy needs to be preserved. prod overlay currently sets `rollingUpdate.maxUnavailable: 1` — that's fine but make sure canary job doesn't rely on exact name `db-creds-staging`.

priya: On RBAC: create a policy `secretsmanager:DescribeSecret` + `GetSecretValue` for role `svc-prod-app`. I can add a quick tf fragment if you want.

morgan: Please add the fragment, priya. Also, olga — any hits on references?

olga: Ran search across manifests and infra modules — found 2 remaining references in `scripts/backup.sh` and `monitoring/probes.yaml`. Created follow-up TODOs in the PR and tagged authors.

sam: If monitoring references change, we should schedule a short deploy window. Are we blocking the promote?

morgan: Not blocking; we can promote and then patch monitoring in a hotfix. But wanted to call out deploy window for the team.

infra-bot: terraform plan job passed with warnings: 1 leaked role binding. See CI details: https://ci.redwood/infrachecks/912

james: Leaked role binding probably from the secretsmanager role change. I'll open a cleanup PR after promote.

priya: Adding TF snippet for secrets policy (apply if approved):
```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "prod_secret_access" {
  name = "prod-secret-access-svc-app"
  role = aws_iam_role.svc_prod_app.name
  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      { Action = ["secretsmanager:GetSecretValue","secretsmanager:DescribeSecret"], Effect = "Allow", Resource = "arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-west-2:123456789012:secret:prod/db-creds*" }
    ]
  })
}
```

morgan: Looks good. If CI and the quick grep pass, I'll merge at 20:00 UTC and do a short canary. Anyone object?

sam: +1

olga: +1

james: +1 — I'll keep an eye on the leaked binding and coordinate cleanup.

priya: +1 and will watch RBAC after deploy.

morgan: Thanks. I'll wait for infra-bot to finish the overlay-validate job then merge. If anything noisy, we can rollback to old secret mapping. :thumbsup:
